parent_ministry: Presidency of the Council of Ministers

facts.value: Central Inspection Board. Administrative oversight body with jurisdiction over all public sector bodies and municipalities. Investigates complaints of administrative misconduct, corruption, negligence, and violations of civil service law. Escalation route when direct complaint to entity fails. Complaint domains encoded for routing: corruption, administrative_misconduct, public_official_negligence, civil_service_violation, municipality_misconduct, public_body_non_response, bribery, conflict_of_interest.

Not responsible for / boundary conditions: field_service_delivery; criminal_prosecution(ISF_judiciary); first_contact_complaints(go_to_entity_first); ordinary_field_service_or_emergency_dispatch; Route instead to MUN_OR_CD_OR_ISF when Central Inspection is oversight and administrative complaint path.
facts.notes: Runtime cases may still require HITL when asset ownership, location, or public/private responsibility is ambiguous.

facts.value: Geographic scope: national. Route oversight complaints to Central Inspection and keep HITL for evidence privacy and criminal-boundary review.
facts.notes: Runtime routing may still need exact location, dynamic municipal resolution, or asset-owner confirmation.

facts.value: Website/form: https://www.cib.gov.lb/en/contact-us; HQ/address: Baydoun Building, Verdun Street, Beirut; Special channels: online_contact_form=cib.gov.lb;complaints=walk_in_registered_mail_or_internet;anonymous_complaints_accepted_for_review; Central Inspection complaint channel: https://www.cib.gov.lb/en/contact-us

facts.value: Escalation/oversight route, not field-service resolver. Channel types: online;walk_in;registered_mail Ticket/reference policy: in_person_complaint_registered_and_slip_with_reference_number_provided Central Inspection complaint: https://www.cib.gov.lb/en/contact-us and https://www.cib.gov.lb/en/node/1029; online form required fields observed 2026-06-01: Full Name, Email, Phone, Administrative Unit, Administration, Add a comment; supports evidence upload up to 10 files, 8 MB each. Procedure page says complaints should include clear useful information, specific facts substantiated by supporting evidence if possible, and should be signed with full name, address and phone number; citizen complaints are addressed to the Presidency of Central Inspection at Baydoun Building, Verdun Street; in-person submission requires ID and produces a registered slip with complaint reference number; registered mail or internet submission is accepted if the same required information is included; anonymous/no-valid-name complaints are referred for consideration without registration and no legal action is taken unless they are serious and include clear specific facts.

facts.human_review_reason: No official public SLA was verified, or the response policy is explicitly unpublished.
